# TSA 23 INV-01 training fixture

Public 14-plot training table copied from
`femic-tsa23-instance/notes/reports/inv01-tsa23-training-plots.csv`.

Columns:

- `site_identifier`, `last_year`
- `lorey_height_m`, `ba_m2_ha`, `vol_m3_ha`
- `Lhmean`, `Lhcv`, `Lhp95`, `CC2m`

The values are public FAIB PSP and LidarBC CHM-proxy evidence. They are used only to
regress the fit pipeline against the published TSA 23 IDF cards; they are not a GNN
calibration.
